Multi-Corner Motif

Praxis Desktop · Settings → Themes → Motif

Corner motif: pick any one to four corners

The corner motif was a single anchor dropdown. It is now a 2×2 box of adorners — each dot sits in the corner it controls, and you toggle as many as you want. Choose top-right + bottom-left and the mark is mirrored into both, each its own layer fading diagonally away from its own corner.

Where it stands now · 23 Sep 2026

The corner picker, live

The 2×2 picker shipped as described. Here it is today with a second corner added, and the window it produces.

  • MovedThe picker now lives in Settings → Surfaces (it was under Themes when this was written).

Screenshots from Praxis desktop v0.3.1 (today's main) · the rest of this page is the original write-up, kept as it was. New: Praxis on Your Phone.

The picker

Settings → Themes → Motif — live on default Parchment

On the window

hexagon motif, anchors: [top-right, bottom-left] — each mark spans the panes it touches, painted background-attachment: fixed

What changed

  • packages/core — SurfaceMotifSettings.anchors?: Corner[] added beside the legacy anchor; validated to the literal set, de-duplicated, capped at 4, dropped when empty so anchor still applies. Two new sanitiser tests.
  • surfacePatterns.ts — resolveSurfacePattern emits one masked data: SVG layer per corner and comma-joins image / size / position / repeat / attachment. A lone corner is byte-identical to before.
  • SettingsPage.tsx — the Anchor <select> becomes a 2×2 corner-toggle group; at least one corner always stays lit.
  • theme.css — .surface-motif-corners grid + per-corner dot placement.
  • New e2e: the corner picker mirrors the motif into every selected corner.

Screenshots from a throwaway Playwright spec on the built renderer. check-types green across all four workspaces; core sanitiser tests 20/20; surfacePacks e2e green (the shared box is heavily loaded — a few launches time out at 30 s and pass on retry). Change on main, working tree only.
